description:
About Optimum

Optimum is building the universal data acceleration network for blockchains, starting with a high-throughput, low-latency networking protocol powered by Random Linear Network Coding (RLNC). Optimum for Validators helps validators propagate blocks and blobs faster; 40+ of the largest Ethereum validators have partnered with us, representing $40B+ in combined ETH stake. Optimum for Traders (Signal and Accelerate) delivers market data and transactions faster than standard TCP connections, especially for participants who are not co-located with exchanges.

The role

You will open and develop sales and partnership relationships across the crypto trading space. That includes trading platforms that serve professional and retail-pro traders — such as CEX and DEX aggregators, copy and social trading apps, bot, AI-assisted, or agentic trading platforms, wallets with trading flow, broker-dealers, and retail-focused prop trading platforms — as well as traders and trading firms themselves. The mandate is the trading space, not a single customer segment; you will also help us shape how we define and prioritize that space.

Your job is to get conversations to the point where our trading and technical team can close: build trust, qualify fit, and bring partners to a pilot or JV/revenue-share discussion. With platform partners, that starts with commercial and go-to-market value — how working with us can help them attract traders or differentiate from competitors — not with a technology pitch alone. Our trading and technical team then takes the conversation into how the product would serve their traders.

This is a combined business development and sales role. We are not splitting those functions at this stage.

What you'll do

  • Build and work a target list of platforms, traders, and trading firms, using market research from Product as input

  • Run first conversations, lead with commercial value, qualify needs (latency sensitivity, pre- vs post-confirmation signal, venues, chains, and how the partner makes money), and hand qualified opportunities to the trading and technical team

  • Bring qualified partners to a pilot or JV/revenue-share discussion

  • Help define and refine the trading space we should be in, based on what you learn in market

  • Feed what you learn back into product and pricing (working closely with Product and the trading team)

  • Keep the pipeline and notes current so the team can see what is happening

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in business development, partnerships or sales, with at least 2 of those years in crypto, digital assets or trading

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

  • Existing relationships in the crypto trading space — across trading platforms, exchanges, aggregators, copy or social trading ecosystems, broker-dealers, prop platforms, and/or traders and trading firms. A network you can put to work from day one is essential. APAC reach is a plus.

  • Experience developing, handing off, and preferably closing partnership, JV, or revenue-share discussions

  • A sales-led, relationship-driven style: you can open doors, show partners the commercial value of working with us, and move conversations toward a deal. This is not a product marketing role.

  • Good intuition for how traders and the platforms that serve them make money

  • Comfortable with technical concepts at a conversational level; deep engineering is not required

  • Self-directed: you own the outreach motion end to end

What we offer

  • Close collaboration with a small, senior, cross-functional team.

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and flexibility.

  • Flexible time off.

  • Fully remote.

  • Work from wherever you do your best thinking. Most of the team operates on ET or CET, so we look for meaningful overlap with those windows (at least 5 hours per day).

  • This is a full-time role with the option to start with a short-term contract.
